description: The observer in `phonemes($) = "ab"` reads the original input through the span projection. The chosen a elides T at 0 and at 2, so the reconstructed input is T A B T, and c reads both synthetic T as bare terminals. a survives only if the sound of $ joins only the original tokens; then a and c are two readings. Read over the reconstructed tokens, the sound is "taabta", a is lost, and c alone would pass (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a [+T="ta"] $x(pair) [+T="ta"]
%conditions phonemes($) = "ab"
%rule b [+T="ta"] [+T="ta"] pair [+T="ta"]
%rule c T="ta" pair T="ta"
%rule pair A B
%rule term T
